resources.string: The household\'s phones share receipts, products and settings directly with each other when they are on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing goes over the internet. Receipt links stay on the phone that scanned them.
Shows a QR code for the other phone
On the other phone, open Eksoda: Settings → Household sync → Join a household, and scan this code. It gives access to the household\'s data, so show it only to its members.
The code could not be made. Try again.
On the other phone: Household sync → Add a phone.
Eksoda needs the camera to read the household code. The camera\'s pictures are never stored or sent anywhere.
Paired with %1$s. The phones sync when they are on the same Wi-Fi.
This is not an Eksoda household code.
This is this phone\'s own code. Scan the code on the other phone\'s screen.
This phone will stop syncing with the phones paired now. Its data stays and will sync with the new household.
This phone stops syncing and forgets the paired phones. Your data stays on this phone.
This phone no longer syncs. Your data stayed here.
Sync was not changed. Try again.
The other phone was syncing at that moment. Try again shortly.
The other phone could not be reached on the network.
The other phone is not paired with this household.
The two phones have different versions of Eksoda. Update the app on both.
Local network access was not allowed.
The received data could not be saved. Nothing changed.
The other phone\'s data could not be read. Nothing changed.
No other phone of the household on this network. The phones need to be on the same Wi-Fi, with Eksoda open.
